Hi Sophie — great to hear, and really appreciate the clear list. Quick answers and proposals below: 

- PO number / line items: yes — we can include the PO number and itemize invoices by SKU. We can emit separate invoice lines for "Dedicated - Reserved" and "Hosted Usage".
- Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoice is fine; we can also provide a statement if required by your AR system.
- Net terms: our standard is net30. For enterprise customers we can consider net45 with finance approval. Alternatively we offer an early-payment incentive (2% if paid within 15 days).
- Documents: attaching our vendor packet (W-9 and banking stub) and a Redwood PO template for your procurement team.
- Blanket PO: we accept blanket/blanket-style POs referencing a deal id — that works. We typically ask for the legal entity on the PO and a primary invoice contact.
- Discount tiers: typical committed-reserved discounts are 15% for a 12-month reserved capacity commitment, 20% for 24 months. For pilots we can discuss a custom uplift if you need accelerated onboarding.

If those terms look reasonable I can loop in Finance and Contracts to get a net45 exception approved and prepare the SOW. What billing entity should we list on our invoices?
